method: Every 4th timeout terminal state, failed-only=False, cold solver cache,400 native steps with constant XML position-actuator controls. Policy queried once from restored observations; alternatives hold current arm joints, optionally reduce gripper closure to2mm or use the reported fixed finger target. CPU and GPU receive identical local state/controls and matched per-world friction. Original evaluation friction is restored from the trace. No policy training, no first-episode success evaluation; steady-control intervention only.
